intro.title: Institutional profile
intro.description1: Schobot is a company working in information and communications technology and in developing knowledge, educational, research and training solutions. Its vision is to use knowledge, specialist expertise and digital technology to offer products and services that help individuals and institutions learn, produce, collaborate and grow.
intro.description2: We are not a substitute for the person or the specialist. We build supportive tools and environments that strengthen their ability to reach knowledge, organize their work and improve productivity, while verification, evaluation and decision-making remain a human responsibility.
intro.description3: Our philosophy: people first, knowledge as the basis of progress, and technology as a tool for empowerment. We measure the value of solutions not by how new the technology is, but by their real benefit to the user, ease of use, quality of output, and respect for privacy and integrity.

mission.title: Integrated solutions for learning, research and collaboration
mission.description: To develop integrated educational, academic, research and technical solutions that combine human expertise, digital innovation and responsible AI, empowering individuals and institutions to learn, produce and collaborate efficiently.

vision.description: To be a trusted knowledge and technology ecosystem that contributes to developing education, scientific research and human empowerment, and to widening access to knowledge and learning.

schobot.seoTitle: Schobot Platform for Researchers | AI in Scientific Research
schobot.title: Researchers Platform and App
schobot.intro: A digital environment for researchers, academics and research teams. It supports organizing the stages of research work, working with references and documents, collaboration and knowledge exchange, and using supporting AI tools. It turns hard-copy knowledge into searchable, citable electronic knowledge, while verification and scientific judgment stay with the researcher.

sections.title: Services and capabilities
items: Smart analysis of literature and references: reading documents and extracting topics, ideas and first summaries.
PDF and document processing: converting and extracting content so it is easier to review and edit, within the supported formats.
Multilingual support: working with material in several languages and translating between the languages the platform supports.
Organizing research work: planning projects and tasks and tracking progress.
Research teams and academic collaboration.
Methodological and statistical support, within the scope of service actually available.
Editing and language proofreading.
Training and consulting in research skills, academic writing and responsible use of AI.

sections.title: Approved platform links
items: Login and registration: app.schobot.com
Website: www.schobot.com

schobot.note: Automated tools support the researcher; checking results and the scientific judgment remain the researcher's responsibility.
schobot.description: A digital environment for researchers, academics and research teams. It supports organizing the stages of research work, working with references and documents, collaboration and knowledge exchange, and using supporting AI tools. It turns hard-copy knowledge into searchable, citable electronic knowledge, while verification and scientific judgment stay with the researcher.

ocr.seoTitle: OCR Service | Converting Scanned Documents into Text
ocr.title: Optical Character Recognition (OCR)
ocr.intro: Double the value of your documents. Convert scanned images of Arabic and English documents into fully editable, searchable text files using the precise RDI engine.

sections.title: What does the service offer?
items: From images to text: converting scanned pages into editable text files.
Arabic and English: support for Arabic and English documents with the RDI engine.
Full text search: searching, editing, copying and archiving.

sections.title: How does it work?
items: Upload your documents: scanned images or files.
The engine processes them: it recognizes the characters and converts the pages to text.
You get fully editable, searchable text files.

sections.title: Who is it for?
items: Universities and researchers: digitizing references, books and theses, and preparing texts for analysis in the researchers platform.
Libraries, publishers and archives: digitizing and indexing books and archives.
Institutions: archiving paper documents and correspondence.

ocr.description: Double the value of your documents. Convert scanned images of Arabic and English documents into fully editable, searchable text files using the precise RDI engine.

publishing.title: Publishing and Digital Publishing
publishing.intro: We prepare scientific and educational content for print and electronic publishing and follow its steps through, and we are working on two future tracks: digitizing Islamic studies and manuscripts, and simplifying science for children through books and interactive media.

sections.title: Available services
items: Academic and educational publishing: preparing university books, research and educational content for publication, with language proofreading, layout and follow-up.
Electronic publishing: preparing content in searchable, shareable digital formats, and benefiting from the OCR service.
Special content and projects: authoring and producing content with experts, and partnerships with publishers, universities and libraries.

sections.title: Future track 1: digitizing Islamic studies and manuscripts (coming soon)
items: Scanning manuscripts and Islamic studies digitally.
Converting them into searchable text with the RDI engine.
Organized digital indexing and archiving.
Making them available to researchers and institutions under scholarly controls.

sections.title: Future track 2: simplifying science for children (coming soon)
items: Illustrated books that simplify scientific concepts.
Interactive media and electronic educational games.
Content written by scientists and researchers and produced by Schobot teams.
Suitable for children, schools and training centers.

publishing.note: The two future tracks are in preparation; no launch dates are given until they are approved.
